summary: All four phases delivered their stated objectives. Phase-01 replaced the routing schemas and resolution core as specified, with unplanned file touches that were all mandatory cascades of the schema change (telemetry events, codex adapter, integration snapshots). Phase-02 added the run-start preflight as a pure domain function wired through executePlan, with two unplanned files (errors.ts and runLayers.ts) justified as mandatory for cross-layer import and exit-code mapping. Phase-03 delivered the catalog codegen script with drift-check integration, with .oxfmtrc.json as an unplanned but necessary formatter exclusion. Phase-04 refreshed the docs and skills, with an extra touch to the generator (only viable write path due to permission gating) and a justified non-edit of agent.ts (already correct from phase-01). Every deviation is recorded and justified in the phase handoffs.

findings.message: Delivered. ModelRoutingSchema v2, ProviderConfigSchema with per-entry catalog, catalog.ts helpers, rewritten resolveModel, and removal of normalizedTier from all surfaces confirmed.
No preflight, codegen, or doc changes introduced. Excluded scope respected.

Ten unplanned files touched: telemetry events/snapshot (defined normalizedTier), codexCli infra/test (read old families[gpt].model shape), three integration tests (mocked RoutingResolution included normalizedTier), two integration snapshots (re-recorded), agent.test.ts, and modelResolved.test.ts. All are mandatory cascades of the schema change. .agents/skills/phax-spec/SKILL.md is a pre-existing dirty worktree file, not scope creep. All deviations justified in handoff.

All planned test files confirmed: catalog.test.ts, resolve.test.ts, schemas.test.ts, effortLevels.test.ts, sameFamilyPreservation.test.ts, securityFallback.test.ts, loadRouting.test.ts, type/routing.ts.
resolveModel signature unchanged. RoutingResolution shape minus normalizedTier as specified. Catalog and equivalence data enter only through decoded config.
Subject matches exactly: feat(routing): replace tier scale with versioned catalog and equivalence table.
Covers all required content: resolver signature, RoutingResolution fields, catalog.ts export names and signatures, equivalence star-lookup semantics, and deviation justifications.
Delivered. preflightPhaseModels is pure, called in executePlan after mcpAllowlistPreflight and before the phase loop, and ModelPreflightError with exit code 11 is wired through runLayers.ts.
Resolution algorithm untouched. No codegen or doc changes. Excluded scope respected.

Two unplanned files: src/domain/errors.ts (ModelPreflightError must live here for cross-layer import without circulars) and src/cli/commands/runLayers.ts (must enumerate all ExecutePlanError variants for correct exit codes). Both justified in handoff.
All three promised test files confirmed: preflight.test.ts (16 unit tests) and modelPreflight.test.ts (4 integration tests). Test layer matches plan.
preflightPhaseModels is domain-layer pure. executePlan renders only through OutputPort. No validation logic in the app layer.
Subject matches exactly: feat(routing): refuse unrunnable plans at run-start model preflight.
Covers preflightPhaseModels signature, failures shape, placement in executePlan, and deviation justifications for both unplanned files.

Delivered. generate-model-catalog.ts renders a Markdown table from DEFAULT_PROVIDER_CONFIG into marker-delimited regions of both phax-planning skill files. --check mode diffs and exits non-zero on drift. Both gen:model-catalog and gen:model-catalog --check are wired into package.json and the phax full gate profile.
No prose rewrites reserved for phase-04, no routing behavior changes. Excluded scope respected.

.oxfmtrc.json was unplanned. Justified: oxfmt reformats .agents/ markdown tables (column-padding), causing generated content to diverge from committed content and breaking --check after every pnpm format. Excluding .agents mirrors the pre-existing .claude exclusion.
tests/unit/generateModelCatalog.test.ts confirmed with all four exported helpers (renderCatalogTable, rewriteMarkerRegion, hasStaleRegion, applyToContent) under test.
Generator owns the marker region; humans own surrounding prose. --check is the drift gate. Contracts respected.
Subject matches exactly: build(routing): generate the planner catalog table with a drift-checked script.
Covers generator command names, marker strings, confirmation of both drift-check integrations (package.json and phax.json), and .oxfmtrc.json deviation justification.

Delivered. docs/model-routing.md fully rewritten without tier language, documenting versioned catalog, Claude-hub star, allowDowngrade, and preflight. .claude/skills/model-routing/SKILL.md aligned. Both phax-planning skills have updated prose before the generated region.
No routing behavior, schema, preflight, or codegen behavior changes. The generator extension (applyPlanningSkillProse) is non-behavioral and does not affect --check mode. Excluded scope respected.

Two deviations: scripts/generate-model-catalog.ts was an extra touch (justified: .claude/ writes are permission-gated; the generator is the only approved write path). src/cli/commands/agent.ts was NOT touched (justified: already correct from phase-01 with no tier output).
tests/unit/cli/agent.test.ts was optional and not needed since agent.ts required no change. No promised tests skipped without justification.
No architectural boundary change. agent.ts remains a thin view over resolveModel.
Subject matches exactly: docs(routing): describe catalog, equivalence, and preflight; drop the tier scale.
Covers confirmation that docs/model-routing.md has no tier references, both file deviation justifications, and a forward-looking maintenance note for MODEL_ROUTING_SKILL_CONTENT.

attentionPoints: Alternatives in preflight error output: ModelPreflightError.failures carries 'reasons' but not 'alternatives'. The plan specifies that the run-start failure message should print alternatives so the planning agent can self-correct. Whether alternatives reach the CLI output depends on how executePlan renders PreflightFailure results before constructing the error. Verify via code review or a real run with an invalid phase model.

MODEL_ROUTING_SKILL_CONTENT maintenance burden: Phase-04 embedded the model-routing skill prose as a hard-coded string in scripts/generate-model-catalog.ts. Future routing layer changes require a manual update to that string or the skill will drift.

.agents/skills/phax-spec/SKILL.md pre-existing dirty state: This file was modified before phase-01 began and was not reverted. The content change is unrelated to this plan. It should be reviewed and committed or reverted separately.
pointers: Possible missing alternatives in CLI preflight output — preflightPhaseModels returns failures with alternatives, but ModelPreflightError.failures omits them; confirm whether executePlan surfaces alternatives in the rendered output before constructing the error (src/app/executePlan.ts, preflight rendering path).
